event_data.context: Filesystem journal merged in PR #4. Reconciliation PR #5 passed CI and returned to draft for App findings. Review identified causal ordering of local resolutions, incomplete ancestry diagnostics, and checkpoint prefix invalidation. Two further findings concern behavior explicitly present in the pinned Rust 2.1.0 baseline: common ancestry closes forks and branch callbacks receive one transaction per claim. Investigating these against the parity requirement before revising.
event_data.summary: Port and verify the durable storage and command state capabilities of EventCore 2.1.0 on Erlang/OTP.
event_data.title: Durable storage and command state
